description: This is a Java source file defining step definitions for testing journal entries in an API-based financial application, using Cucumber for BDD testing, handling journal entry verification, API calls, and test context management.

classes.name: JournalEntriesStepDef
classes.description: Defines Cucumber step definitions for testing journal entries associated with loans and transactions in the Fineract API.

methods.name: journalEntryDataCheck
methods.description: Verifies journal entries for a specific transaction type and date against expected data.

methods.name: checkJournalEntryData
methods.description: Validates that actual journal entries match expected data from a Cucumber DataTable.

methods.name: getJournalLinesActualList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of journal entry items for a list of matched transactions.

methods.name: journalEntryNoDataCheck
methods.description: Checks that no journal entries exist for a specific transaction.

methods.name: addManualJournalEntryWithoutExternalAssetOwner
methods.description: Creates a manual journal entry without specifying an external asset owner.

methods.name: addManualJournalEntryWithExternalAssetOwner
methods.description: Creates a manual journal entry with an external asset owner.

methods.name: createManualJournalEntryWithExternalAssetOwner
methods.description: Wrapper to create manual journal entry with external asset owner, invoked by a step.

methods.name: createManualJournalEntryWithEmptyExternalAssetOwner
methods.description: Wrapper to create manual journal entry with empty external asset owner.

methods.name: createManualJournalEntryWithoutExternalAssetOwner
methods.description: Wrapper to create manual journal entry without external asset owner.

methods.name: checkManualJournalEntry
methods.description: Verifies manual journal entry details against expected data, including external asset owner.
